title: Help us find this business: a public request for businesses we know only by name and town
why: Jason, 2026-11-15 (in chat): "build the Help us find this business card" (decisions/0164 §3.5: "A find with only a name and a town gets a public 'Help us find this business' card"). The listings Data cleanup took off with the target help_find (no address, no phone) now show as requests, never listings (no pin, no Call or Directions, no confidence badge): on their town's page (the Local section, website/hub/index.php) and in search (UniversalSearch::searchAs adds 'help' beside 'Named on pages we read'; js/search-panel.js helpHtml). Each asks "Know its phone or address?" (js/suggest.js: a Help us find form with phone, street address, website and How do you know?, sent as a fix suggestion to Review, R4) and "Is it yours? Claim it" (Claims::listing now accepts these cards). Once a phone or street address is on it (a fix accepted in Review, the owner's own entry), HelpFind::promoteSome puts it back on the site as a listing, with a 'found' note. Names: never page text, a person's name (R6), a protected or confidential name (R7); a card nobody answers in 180 days (the retry ladder's long wait) isn't shown, kept, and an answer brings it back. Data cleanup's page shows how many are asked about, found and not shown. Also (Jason: "drop boxes are good to know"): drop and collection boxes are no longer page text in DataCleanup::junkName; mailing addresses ("PO Box 190") still are; the ones taken off can be put back with Undo. FAQ: one visitor entry, one staff entry. No migration. Undo by reason (Jason, 2026-11-15: "Undo all" for the drop boxes): each pass under Passes groups its changes by reason, with Undo all N for one reason (DataCleanup::groups, undoGroup), so the drop boxes taken off as "A mail or drop box, not a business" go back in one press. PO Boxes stay as mailing addresses on listings (only a PO Box as a business's name is page text); they don't count as a street address for the floor.
